visualCharacteristics.purpose: Frequently asked questions list with expand/collapse answers
description: Divider-separated numbered questions with caret, inside light-blue panel, show-more after 6

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: question text (include numbering if desired, e.g. "1. ..."); cell 2: answer rich text. When there are more than 6 items, the rest are hidden behind a "see more" button
notes: Expand/collapse question-and-answer list is an interactive component.

usage: Use for FAQ sections with question/answer pairs.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any question/answer or expand/collapse list; lists of 6 or fewer show no "see more" button.
